# Kakkoi School AI Handbook

Purpose: deterministic instructions for AI assistants helping students with Git, GitHub, GitHub Pages, and Kakkoi School project workflows.

Start here:
- New student bootstrap: https://github.com/KakkoiSchool/ai-handbook/blob/main/START-HERE.md
- First-day student setup: https://github.com/KakkoiSchool/ai-handbook/blob/main/setup/README.md
- https://github.com/KakkoiSchool/ai-handbook/blob/main/AGENTS.md
- https://github.com/KakkoiSchool/ai-handbook/blob/main/recipes/README.md

- Git: https://github.com/KakkoiSchool/ai-handbook/blob/main/setup/git.md
- VS Code: https://github.com/KakkoiSchool/ai-handbook/blob/main/setup/vscode.md
- VS Code + GitHub: https://github.com/KakkoiSchool/ai-handbook/blob/main/setup/vscode-github.md
- Copilot Free / Student: https://github.com/KakkoiSchool/ai-handbook/blob/main/setup/copilot.md
- Live Server: https://github.com/KakkoiSchool/ai-handbook/blob/main/setup/live-server.md
- Local server explanation: https://github.com/KakkoiSchool/ai-handbook/blob/main/setup/local-server.md
- Setup health check: https://github.com/KakkoiSchool/ai-handbook/blob/main/setup/check-setup.sh

Rule: do not guess a workflow if one of these recipes covers the task. Verify the final state before saying the task succeeded.
